name: World
vision_statement: What lies beyond a person's Quest reaches the AI through one measured path.
opportunities: Models, search backends and tools change faster than the assistant does, so reaching them through one measured path lets the best one run as they move.
solution_coherence: World is how the assistant learns what lies outside it and acts on it. Model Plumbing asks a model through one measured path. Science answers from public research with its source shown. Tools lets the assistant use the tool of each category the person's authority allows.
